gaps.sentence: He demands ___ answer before the end of the day.
My grandmother goes to ___ church every morning before work.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to church' (as worshipper) takes no article; 'the church' would mean the building.

gaps.sentence: What ___ pity that the show closed so soon.
gaps.explanation: 'What a pity' is the fixed exclamatory phrase.

gaps.sentence: This is ___ second time you've been late this week.
She goes to the gym twice ___ week.
gaps.explanation: 'Twice a week' — rates take 'a' (= per). The other gap is 'the gym'.

gaps.sentence: He considers himself ___ expert on medieval art.
gaps.explanation: 'An expert' — 'expert' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ heir to a shipping fortune.
gaps.explanation: 'Heir' begins with a vowel sound — the h is silent.

gaps.sentence: There was ___ enormous queue for the tickets.
gaps.explanation: 'Enormous' starts with a vowel sound, so 'an enormous queue'.
